title: Registry of Coronary Artery Ill Patients With Platelet Test Results
summary: ONASSIST is a registry of coronary ill patients who have had a functional test measuring anti-platelet effect and/or a genetic profile of response to anti-platelet drugs.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* coronary disease
* antiplatelets testing performed as part of usual care and / or gentic profile of antiplatelet response done

Exclusion Criteria:

* patient refusing to be part of the registry
